model_output.rationale: Both lines carry CO-29 + N211. DOS 2024-07-19; Medicare 1-year limit = 2025-07-19. The 837P hitting Novitas was dated 2025-10-13 — 86 days late. However, the 277CA shows a front-end acceptance (A2:20) on 2024-07-23, four days after DOS, proving the original claim was received within the filing window. Per timely-filing.md, a 277CA acceptance report is the strongest proof of timely filing; CO-29 is disputable.

root_cause.explanation: 837P submitted 2025-10-13 — past the 1-year Medicare deadline from DOS 2024-07-19. But the 277CA (2024-07-23) shows A2 front-end acceptance of the original, timely submission.

next_action.detail: File a Medicare redetermination disputing the receipt date. Attach the 277CA A2:20 acceptance from 2024-07-23 as proof the original claim was received within the 1-year window. Do not plead forgiveness — dispute that filing was late.

evidence.fact: CAS*CO*29 on both service lines; MOA N211; $0 paid; DOS 2024-07-19
CLM05-3=1 (original); ISA date 2025-10-13 — 86 days past the 1-year Medicare filing limit
STC*A2:20 acceptance dated 2024-07-23 for TRC40749676, matching the 837P BHT reference — original received within the filing window
Timely-filing.md: clearinghouse acceptance report is the strongest proof; appeal to dispute receipt date, not plead forgiveness. N211 applied in error when timely filing is provable (R3118CP).

citations.rule: Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with clearinghouse acceptance report
Medicare FFS: 1 calendar year from DOS; 42 CFR 424.44
